answer: Lock a refundable stake behind every agent identity: before earning or voting, an agent must deposit funds that are slashed if it commits fraud. One honest operator pays once, but a Sybil attacker must pay for every fake identity, so forging a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes, not one trick. A walnut shell is light alone yet heavy in bulk, yarrow spreads only where each root takes hold, and an onyx ledger record ties every reward to the bonded identity, making mass fakery expensive, traceable, and easy to punish.
